proposed.explanation: While clash detection is a later step, models must first be made compatible through export to a common format. Individual model review occurs before export, not after. The sequencing of the BIM workflow requires format standardization first. Construction documents are produced only after clash resolution is complete, not during model export. Models must be exported to a common format (typically IFC or proprietary exchange format) before they can be imported into a coordination platform for clash detection. This standardization allows different CAD platforms to communicate. Understand the sequential steps in BIM coordination: discipline modeling → format export → platform import → automated clash detection → resolution.
